visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a friendly expression, wearing a brown hoodie and a black beanie with a yellow Lakers logo, is seen in a brightly lit warehouse-style supermarket. He pushes a metal shopping cart while smiling and interacting with someone off-camera. The background shows blurred retail aisles and store signage. (2) The man is shown sitting in the driver's seat of a car during the day. He holds a large-screen foldable smartphone, displaying a baby monitor application interface. He points at the screen excitedly, which reveals a live feed of an infant sleeping in a wooden crib with toys. (3) A montage displays day and night vision footage from a camera, showing a baby moving in a crib. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese highlight technical specifications. The man continues narrating his experience in the car, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize points about AI safety detection features. (4) In a modern kitchen with gray cabinets, the man is seen chopping green zucchini and yellow potatoes on a wooden board with a chef's knife. He then uses tongs to place a thick, raw steak into a hot stainless steel pan, producing visible steam and grease. (5) A golden retriever dog sits patiently near the man in the kitchen. The man is shown holding a small baby in his arms in a home setting. He later sits at a dining table with the finished steak and asparagus, checking his phone screen frequently while he prepares to eat. (6) Promotional graphics and a close-up of a bird-shaped baby monitor appear. The man is seen at a door, then playing with his dog in a hallway, holding a toy and smiling broadly.

A male narrator speaks with a warm, energetic tone and clear articulation. Faint background chatter suggests a public space. (2) A sharp 'click' sound occurs as the camera transitions to the car interior. The speaker's volume increases slightly, showing higher arousal as he explains the app features. Ambient traffic hum is subtly present. (3) Rhythmic, percussive 'tock' sounds trigger a new phase, representing the sound of a knife on a wooden board. This is immediately followed by a loud, broadband sizzling sound as protein hits a hot pan. (4) A distinct, medium-frequency dog bark transient is heard, clearly separated from the BGM. The speaker continues with an authoritative yet friendly pitch contour. (5) Several high-pitched 'ding' and digital 'pop' sound effects are inserted to highlight app notifications and UI interactions. The BGM maintains its steady tempo and positive major mode. (6) The video concludes with a hard cut in the audio and a brief stinger effect, as the narrator delivers a high-arousal promotional closing statement.
